articles.title: Man, 61, dies after being struck by vehicle in Scarborough: police
articles.summary: A 61-year-old man has died after he was struck by a vehicle in Scarborough Saturday, Toronto police say.

articles.title: 2 teens dead, 1 injured after shooting at Scarborough gas station: Toronto police
articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating a homicide after two 16-year-old boys died and another sustained serious injuries following a shooting in Scarborough in the early hours of Sunday.

articles.title: Black creatives at Brampton conference vow to transform future of arts industry
articles.summary: A group of Black creatives met in Brampton over the weekend to re-envision how they can strengthen the arts sector for Black artists.

articles.title: 'We deserve answers,' says laid-off Stellantis worker | Hanomansing Live
articles.summary: The federal and Ontario governments met with Stellantis executives Friday in a last-ditch effort to save the Brampton, Ont., auto plant. Samantha Lafave, who was laid off by Stellantis in 2023, says she and her husband, who was also laid off, are 'tired of holding our breath,' though she remains optimistic something positive will come out of the meeting.

articles.title: Mississauga rock band Billy Talent recognized for support of mental health charity
articles.summary: Mississauga's punk rock band Billy Talent received an award from the Mississauga Arts Council this week, acknowledging the band's work outside of music. They have supported mental health charity Make Music Matter for 15 years, which uses songwriting as a therapeutic tool to help empower and heal. CBC Peel host Nav Nanwa has the story.

articles.title: Child attacked by coyote at Edwards Gardens in Toronto, police say
articles.summary: Police are warning the public after a coyote attacked a child in a northeast Toronto park this week.
